# PI-MVP-003 — Integration and MVP Release

**Status:** Forecast  
**Forecast:** 2026-10-12 through 2026-11-08

## Objective

Integrate native validation/change intelligence, dogfood Monad, package/document the product, assemble release provenance, and prove MVP acceptance.

## Work Cycles

- WC-MVP-0009 Change intelligence/native validation
- WC-MVP-0010 Dogfood and GitHub projection
- WC-MVP-0011 Packaging/docs/provenance
- WC-MVP-0012 Acceptance and release

## Included Work Packets

WP-MVP-0024 through WP-MVP-0033.

## Exit

M-003 and Product Goal PG-001 are accepted; MVP Release 1 is published or the review records the exact blocking evidence.
